info.title: Moneykeeper
info.description: Moneykeeper context-first contract mounted by the default runtime at unversioned paths.

get.description: Live surviving ordinary Ledger journals, one currency, current taxonomy. At All categories, a top-level expense-kind group named Expenses (case-insensitive) exposes immediate child subtrees and a separate direct-assignment row; other roots retain subtree grouping. Uncategorized and historical archived activity remain included. Corrections restate their occurrence period. Unknown parameters return 400. Taxonomy changes retry once, then return 409. Series buckets are clipped calendar intervals; trends are six or twelve calendar months ending at to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive occurrence instant. Each range may intersect at most 366 local dates.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone in PostgreSQL timezone catalogue; UTC is accepted.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: One registered native currency; disabled historical currencies are accepted.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: User-owned category. Includes archived descendants by default.

parameters.name: uncategorized
parameters.description: True conflicts with category_id and explicit category_scope.

get.description: Live surviving ordinary Ledger journals, one currency, current taxonomy. Corrections restate their occurrence period. Unknown parameters return 400. Taxonomy changes retry once, then return 409. Cursor fields must be supplied together. Occurrence and sequence descending; summary ignores cursor and limit. Page and summary share a read-only repeatable-read snapshot. Later pages read fresh data; as_of is not a snapshot token. Expense contribution is negative expenses, Income is income, All is net including mixed zero-net journals.

get.description: Returns immutable transactions in deterministic effective-time and sequence order.
Returns manual tenant-owned security definitions without consulting an external registry.
Returns one manual instrument with explicit coupon and maturity terms.

post.description: Records an ОВДП instrument with absolute face value, currency, dates, and explicit coupon knowledge.
Records an opening, buy, sell, coupon, redemption, or correction with position-version fencing.

get.description: Returns exact quantity, known and unknown cost, realized result, and latest valuation state.
Returns append-only absolute price and accrued-interest observations in deterministic order.

post.description: Appends an absolute per-instrument valuation and updates only rebuildable market-value projections.

get.description: Returns the enabled currencies recognized by Reference Data, ordered by currency code. This is a side-effect-free catalog query; disabled currencies are not included.
Returns one enabled currency by its canonical three-letter uppercase code. Missing and disabled currencies are both reported as not found, and the query does not change catalog state.

post.description: Creates a node at the requested parent and sibling position when expected_version matches the user's taxonomy. The operation lazily installs starter template version 1 only when the user has never had category rows.

201.description: Created category node and current taxonomy version

get.description: Returns the user's complete active and archived category hierarchy, its global version, effective lifecycle and inherited styling, paths, depths, assignability, and the installed starter-template version.
Returns one tenant-owned category and all its descendants together with the current taxonomy version. Missing and tenant-hidden nodes are both reported as not found.

patch.description: Updates present name, color, or icon fields against the taxonomy version; explicit null clears stored styling. Category kind is immutable.

post.description: Atomically moves one subtree to a parent and target sibling position while rejecting cycles, incompatible kinds, and trees deeper than three levels.

put.description: Replaces the dense zero-based order for one sibling set. The request must contain every sibling, including archived nodes, exactly once.

post.description: Archives the node locally at the expected taxonomy version. Descendants become effectively archived without changing their own lifecycle values, while historical references remain valid.
Restores the node's local lifecycle at the expected taxonomy version. It conflicts if the effective sibling name would no longer be unique; individually archived descendants remain archived.

get.description: Returns the ordered server-owned semantic icon catalog accepted by category mutations.
Returns the authenticated user's effective preferences. If no row has been stored, the response uses base currency UAH with version 0 and persisted false without inserting data.

patch.description: Sets the authenticated user's base currency to an enabled catalog currency using optimistic concurrency. expected_version 0 creates the first persisted preference at version 1; later changes must provide the current version and increment it on success.

post.description: Opens a tenant-owned manual account and records a non-zero opening balance through an immutable balanced journal. Requires Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's visible active and archived accounts with exact signed and display balances.
Returns one tenant-owned account; another user's identity is indistinguishable from a missing account.

patch.description: Renames account metadata using expected_version and an Idempotency-Key without changing its currency or accounting facts.

post.description: Archives an account at expected_version while preserving its full balance and immutable journal history.
Restores an archived account at expected_version without rewriting any historical accounting facts.

get.description: Lists immutable journal details with stable occurred-at and ledger-sequence cursor ordering.

Omitted or false uncategorized applies no restriction.

Atomically posts a same-currency or FX transfer, optional fee, exact implied rate, and all clearing legs.

get.description: Returns pending classification suggestions oldest first. A stable cursor requires both after_created_at and after_decision_id; limit defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 100.

post.description: Accepts, corrects, or rejects one pending suggestion under both decision and annotation version fences. Accepted and corrected outcomes become manual assignments; application completes asynchronously.
Starts or idempotently returns one user-owned backfill over a non-empty half-open UTC range. Only one active backfill per user is allowed.

get.description: Returns state, newest-first scan cursor, outcome counters, optimistic version, and any UTC quota-resume time for one tenant-owned backfill.
Lists provider-neutral balance observations and their immutable decision state for the authenticated tenant.
Returns one tenant case including provider values, captured Ledger balance and version, delta, and status.

post.description: Posts a visible correction only when both case expected_version and captured expected_balance_version still match.
Dismisses one pending case at expected_version without creating any journal or changing a balance.
Accepts a Monobank token for encrypted validation and resource discovery without returning the secret.

HideReversed.name: hide_reversed
HideReversed.description: Hide reversal journals and any journal reversed by another journal for the same user, before pagination and summary aggregation. Reversals outside the selected date/category filters still hide their originals. Composes with grouped_transfers; balances, ledger history, and detail-by-ID access are unchanged.

CategoryIdFilter.name: category_id
CategoryIdFilter.description: Matches assignments to this category or any active or archived descendant.

UncategorizedFilter.name: uncategorized
UncategorizedFilter.description: When true, returns only transactions without a category. Mutually exclusive with category_id.
